# Subway Seat for gh-dash

Parchment text, orange borders on the active section and a warm selected row, with author-role icons in the palette's accents.

[gh-dash](https://github.com/dlvhdr/gh-dash) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/gh-dash/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.yml`](subway-seat.yml) | ~/.config/gh-dash/subway-seat.yml |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.yml`](subway-seat-tunnel.yml) | ~/.config/gh-dash/subway-seat-tunnel.yml |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.yml`](subway-seat-enamel.yml) | ~/.config/gh-dash/subway-seat-enamel.yml |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/gh-dash/config.yml (gh-dash 4.25+; on older releases paste the theme block in):

```yaml
include:
  - ~/.config/gh-dash/subway-seat.yml
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/gh-dash/config.yml (gh-dash 4.25+; on older releases paste the theme block in):

```yaml
include:
  - ~/.config/gh-dash/subway-seat-tunnel.yml
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/gh-dash/config.yml (gh-dash 4.25+; on older releases paste the theme block in):

```yaml
include:
  - ~/.config/gh-dash/subway-seat-enamel.yml
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
